title: KLIA2 Luggage Storage: Where to Leave Your Bags
metaDescription: KLIA2 luggage storage counters on Level 1 and Level 2, open 24 hours. Rates as listed, what they refuse, and the lockers at Lalaport in KL.

contentBlocks.content: KLIA2 luggage storage is in the public area of the airport, after immigration and customs. Baggage Solutions runs two staffed counters at Gateway@klia2, one on Level 2 by the arrival hall and one on Level 1, the bus floor, and both are open 24 hours (Baggage Solutions). Malaysia Airports also lists a second operator, Smart Storage, on Level 2 in the arrival hall public concourse (Malaysia Airports). Leave your suitcase, take the bus into Kuala Lumpur with a day bag, and collect it on your way back.
Key Takeaways
Where is luggage storage at KLIA2? At Gateway@klia2, on Level 2 (arrival hall side) and Level 1 (bus, e-hailing and car rental floor). Smart Storage is also on Level 2.
Is it open at night? Yes. Baggage Solutions runs both counters 24 hours a day.
How much does it cost? Baggage Solutions charges per item per 24 hours by size. As listed on 5 Nov 2026, a small bag is RM18 and a large suitcase RM38 a day for the first six days.
Can I use it on a transit layover? Only if you clear immigration first. Both services are in the public area of the airport.
What do I need to bring? Your passport. Staff scan it for the storage record and give you a receipt to claim your bag.
Where the counters are
Both Baggage Solutions counters are in the Gateway@klia2 public concourse, the shopping area you walk through when you leave the arrival hall (Baggage Solutions):

• Counter L2, Lot L2-136. Level 2, on the arrival hall side. Use this one if you want to drop your bags as soon as you land.
  • Counter L1, Lot L1-8. Level 1, the bus, e-hailing and car rental floor. This is the floor of the KLIA2 bus counter, so you can store your bags and walk straight to your bus.
Malaysia Airports lists Smart Storage at unit S2-2-L11, Level 2, Arrival Level (Public Concourse) (Malaysia Airports). Ask at the counter for its hours and rates.
New to the building? Our KLIA2 arrival hall guide shows the exits, and the KLIA2 bus station guide walks you from Door B down to Level 1.
How it works at the counter
This is a staffed counter, not a self service locker bank. Walk ins are welcome (Baggage Solutions).

1. Hand over your bag and say how long you need.
  2. Show your passport. Staff scan it for the transaction record.
  3. Staff confirm the size category. They may inspect the bag and can refuse items.
  4. Pay and keep the receipt. You need it to collect your bag. Check the expiry date and time before you walk away.

You can pay in ringgit by cash, credit card, Alipay or Touch 'n Go eWallet. There is no refund if you collect early. Keeping a bag past the agreed time costs extra, and a bag left more than three months after the collection date may be disposed of (Baggage Solutions storage rules).
What it costs
Baggage Solutions rack storage rates as listed on 5 Nov 2026, per item per 24 hours (Baggage Solutions price list). The longer you store, the less each day costs.

Size (approx.)1 to 6 days7 to 14 days15 days or more
Small, 43 x 31 x 21 cmRM18RM15RM13
Medium, 60 x 42 x 25 cmRM28RM22RM20
Large, 67 x 46 x 31 cmRM38RM32RM30
Extra large, bicycle or surfboardRM48RM42RM40

A private locker costs more: RM38 a day for a medium locker and RM48 for a large one, for the first six days. Hourly rates are not published, so ask at the counter if you only need a few hours. Staff set the final category and the operator says prices can change without notice (Baggage Solutions price list).
What they will not take

Baggage Solutions does not accept wet food that smells, especially meat or dairy, or anything that needs a fridge. Live animals, pets and plants are out. So are dangerous goods, chemicals, flammable or explosive materials, weapons and anything leaking. Keep your passport, cash, laptop, jewellery and other valuables with you (Baggage Solutions storage rules).
Before you hand over your bag, take out your phone charger and anything you need before you come back. You cannot open the bag again without collecting it.
When storing at the airport makes sense
A long layover going into KL

Clear immigration, store your bags at the Level 1 counter and walk to the bus counter on the same floor. The bus to KL Sentral puts you on the train network. Our KLIA2 to KL Sentral guide compares it with the train and Grab. Leave time to come back, collect your bag and check in again.
Your hotel check in is hours away

Landed at dawn and the room is not ready until the afternoon? You have two choices. Store your bags at KLIA2 and come back for them, or take them into town and ask your hotel to hold them. Ask the hotel before you fly whether it holds bags before check in, and get a tag or receipt when you hand them over.
A day trip or a few nights away
Flying out of KLIA2 again in a few days? Leave the big suitcase at the airport and travel with a small bag. The daily rate drops after six days, which helps on a longer trip.
Lockers at the Lalaport hub in Bukit Bintang

If you are going into the city anyway, you can take your bags with you and use the lockers at the Lalaport Transportation Hub in LaLaport BBCC. There are 36 lockers near the bus bays, from RM20 to RM55 per day depending on size, and you can open yours as many times as you like within the 24 hours (The Straits Times). The bus from KLIA2 to Lalaport BBCC drops you at the hub in Bukit Bintang. Read our Lalaport Transportation Hub guide for the way in and what else is there.

content.heading: Bags stored? Pick your bus into the city
content.subheading: Buses leave the KLIA2 Transportation Hub on Level 1 for KL Sentral, Pudu Sentral, Lalaport BBCC and TBS. See times and book on ttklia.com.

contentBlocks.content: Frequently Asked Questions
Is there luggage storage at KLIA2?

Yes. Baggage Solutions has two counters at Gateway@klia2, Lot L2-136 on Level 2 and Lot L1-8 on Level 1, both open 24 hours. Malaysia Airports also lists Smart Storage on Level 2 in the arrival hall public concourse.
How much is luggage storage at KLIA2?
At Baggage Solutions, as listed on 5 Nov 2026, it is RM18 a day for a small bag, RM28 for medium, RM38 for large and RM48 for extra large, for the first six days. Longer stays cost less per day.
Is KLIA2 luggage storage open 24 hours?
Baggage Solutions runs both its KLIA2 counters 24 hours a day, every day. For Smart Storage, check the hours at the counter.
Can I store luggage at KLIA2 during a transit?
Only after you clear immigration. The storage counters are in the public area of the airport, so you need to enter Malaysia to reach them.
Where else can I leave my bags in Kuala Lumpur?
The Lalaport Transportation Hub in Bukit Bintang has 36 lockers near the bus bays, RM20 to RM55 per day by size. You can reach it by bus straight from KLIA2.
Conclusion

KLIA2 luggage storage is easy to find: Level 2 by the arrival hall, or Level 1 next to the buses. Bring your passport and keep the receipt safe. Then pick your bus into Kuala Lumpur on ttklia.com and travel light.
